_what: The instance half of the `reachability` verb: WHICH scripts mark a production Discord gateway, where its log lands relative to the worktree it runs from, who counts as the operator, and how this deployment reaches the operator's phone.
_readme: Core code (core/comm/reachability.py) asks here instead of naming these values -- the Local-in-Core ratchet refuses a seat name, an absolute home path or a port inside Core, and these are exactly that class. Every value has an AKASHIC_* env override named beside it. Committed on purpose: these are house defaults, not secrets.

operator_ids._what: Senders whose mail IS the operator. Read by core/comm/reachability.py; scripts/bifrost_wake.py's operator override reads AKASHIC_OPERATOR_IDS (comma-separated, empty disables the override), which wins over this list.

gateway._what: How a production Discord gateway is RECOGNISED, and where its real log lands. A gateway is a python process one of whose ARGUMENTS is one of these scripts -- matched on the script argument, never on prose inside a command line (the first draft of the verb matched the joined cmdline and reported a gateway that did not exist).
gateway._why_relpath: Resolved against the PROCESS's working directory, not this checkout: the deployed gateway runs from its own worktree (2026-10-31: C:/Users/L5/AppData/Local/AkashicAurora/worktrees/sunshine-discord-split), so this checkout's state/logs is the wrong answer by construction.

phone._what: The PhoneLink watcher's `ssh -R` forward: the phone's tailnet address, its sshd port, and the phone-side loopback ports the watcher forwards to this PC whenever PC-Link is on.
phone._source: E:/dev/phonelink/phonelink.ps1 ($Tailnet, $Port, $Bifrost, $GamePort); scheduled task PhoneLink-Watcher runs `phonelink.ps1 watch`.
phone._env: AKASHIC_PHONE_TAILNET / AKASHIC_PHONE_PORT override the two numbers at read time.
